title: Reservation Selection Recorded-Held Commitment Resolution
purpose: Compose canonical FOOD-007I latest-recorded selection validation with FOOD-007J exact-revision recorded-held commitment reads for the exact selected capacity-source revisions.
dependencies: FOOD-007F exact reservation capacity-source selection resolution
FOOD-007I reservation capacity-source latest-recorded selection validation
FOOD-007J exact-revision recorded held-capacity commitment read
input: Canonical FOOD-007F FoodReservationCapacitySourceSelectionResolution plus an injected database satisfying FOOD-007I and FOOD-007J read capabilities.
algorithm: Run FOOD-007I against the supplied FOOD-007F resolution.
If FOOD-007I does not return validated, preserve that canonical failure outcome and perform no FOOD-007J reads.
For each validated SKU observation in canonical demand order, require selectedRevision to equal observedHighestRecordedRevision and read FOOD-007J for that exact SKU and selected revision.
Fail closed as storage-failure if an internally constructed FOOD-007J selector is rejected, storage fails, or the returned identity differs from the requested exact identity.
After every SKU commitment read succeeds, perform one FOOD-007J read for the validated exact slot revision.
Return a detached deeply frozen bundle containing the copied FOOD-007I validation, exact SKU commitment observations in demand order, and the exact slot commitment observation.

successOutput.validation: Detached copy of canonical FOOD-007I validation evidence.
successOutput.skuCommitments: One exact SKU id/version + selected capacity revision + recordedHeldQuantity per validated SKU observation in order.
successOutput.slotCommitment: Exact method/location/window + selected capacity revision + recordedHeldQuantity.

outcomes.resolved: FOOD-007I validated the selected revisions and all matching FOOD-007J exact-revision recorded-held reads succeeded.
outcomes.later-recorded-revision: Preserved from FOOD-007I; no FOOD-007J commitment reads occur.
outcomes.not-found: Preserved from FOOD-007I; no FOOD-007J commitment reads occur.
outcomes.invalid: Preserved from FOOD-007I; no FOOD-007J commitment reads occur.
outcomes.storage-failure: Preserved from FOOD-007I or returned when FOOD-007J fails or contradicts the validated exact identity.

safeClaim: At the respective read times, the canonical FOOD-007F selected revisions passed FOOD-007I latest-recorded equality validation, and FOOD-007J returned recorded-held commitment aggregates for those same exact revisions.
concurrency: FOOD-007I latest-recorded reads and FOOD-007J commitment reads are sequential operations under the injected database/session semantics.
FOOD-007K does not claim a fixed simultaneous snapshot across those reads.
A later capacity-source revision may be appended after FOOD-007I validation.
A later held reservation row may be inserted after a FOOD-007J commitment read.
Successful resolution is read-time evidence composition, not perpetual operational authority.
crossRevisionBoundary: FOOD-007K does not roll commitments recorded against one capacity-source revision into another revision.
lifecycleBoundary: Recorded-held commitment evidence is not interpreted as a future canonical active-reservation lifecycle.
arithmeticBoundary: FOOD-007K performs no capacity subtraction, sufficiency comparison, remaining-capacity calculation, reservable-quantity calculation, or ATP calculation.
authorityBoundary: Latest-recorded equality plus exact-revision recorded-held commitment evidence does not establish governing source policy, source eligibility, physical currentness, availability, orderability, checkout readiness, payment readiness, reservation acceptance, or fulfillment authority.
physicalInventoryBoundary: Reservation holds are not physical inventory movements.
sideEffects: Read-only server-library composition through FOOD-007I and FOOD-007J. No direct SQL, writes, routes, clocks, network access beyond the injected database abstraction, environment access, randomness, acceptance construction, migration execution, or production mutation.
